responsibility: Is the build-time generator that reads rs6000-builtin-new.def and rs6000-overload.def and emits the generated headers and initialization sources for PowerPC builtins. It parses the stanza-based builtin and overload descriptions, interns identifiers with its local red-black-tree utilities, constructs builtin/type/overload tables, and writes the generated enum declarations, builtin initialization code, GC/PCH marking helpers, and rs6000-vecdefines.h macro aliases that the backend and public vector headers consume.
